subject.title: ci(mantis): add web UI chat proof lane

question: Should OpenClaw accept this new secret-backed Mantis web UI chat proof lane based on the hosted proof-shim coverage, even though direct workflow-file dispatch cannot be tested until default registration?
rationale: The diff adds issue-comment automation, a candidate execution path, artifact upload, and Mantis GitHub App/R2 publishing; that boundary and the protected maintainer label require human acceptance rather than cleanup automation.

options.title: Accept proof-shim coverage
options.body: Merge after maintainer/security owner review, then verify direct workflow dispatch once the workflow exists on the default branch.

options.title: Require more pre-merge proof
options.body: Pause until maintainers provide an additional default-registered carrier or equivalent workflow proof that satisfies the same secret and artifact boundaries.

options.title: Narrow or drop the publish path
options.body: Keep only the local/browser proof pieces and defer secret-backed Mantis publishing to a later owner-sponsored PR.

recommendation.title: Accept proof-shim coverage
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer/security owner review, then verify direct workflow dispatch once the workflow exists on the default branch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the clearest current-main history owner for the existing Mantis automation and Control UI E2E surfaces touched by this PR.
